visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and straight bangs is shown from the chest up. She wears a black sleeveless top. Bright colored balloons float behind her in a blurred living room setting. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of the same woman sitting on a beige sofa in front of a white brick wall. She is talking directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands. A tattoo is visible on her left forearm. (3) A screen recording of an iPhone interface appears. It shows the camera app, then the user swipes down the Control Center from the top right. A finger taps on the 'Effects' button for Instagram to reveal a sub-menu. (4) The shot returns briefly to the woman making a peace sign, but this time no balloons appear. (5) Back to the woman on the sofa, she continues her explanation, holding a small orange cushion on her lap. (6) Another screen recording shows the Control Center again, focusing on the 'Studio Light' and 'Portrait' effect toggles. (7) A split-screen comparison shows the camera view with lighting effects off (bottom) and on (top), demonstrating a brighter face and darker background. (8) A final split-screen comparison demonstrates the background blur effect. (9) The woman concludes her message while sitting on the sofa, gesturing enthusiastically.
